title: Karnataka Plans Tumakuru Industrial Node Expansion
summary: Karnataka has earmarked 1,736 acres for the Tumakuru Node of the Bengaluru-Chennai Industrial Corridor. The project targets ₹7,000 crore in investment and more than 88,000 jobs, with completion scheduled for 2027....

blocks.content: Karnataka has earmarked 1,736 acres for the Tumakuru Node of the Bengaluru-Chennai Industrial Corridor. The project targets ₹7,000 crore in investment and more than 88,000 jobs, with completion scheduled for 2027.

items: The National Industrial Corridor Development and Implementation Trust is the nodal implementing institution for several industrial corridor projects in India.
Micro, small and medium enterprises are commonly abbreviated as MSMEs in Indian economic policy.
Industrial corridors combine manufacturing zones, logistics links, and urban infrastructure in a planned framework.
Anchor investors are large firms that help initiate industrial cluster development in a project area.
